step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify Actors & Components:
- 'Users' drawn as a user icon on the far left.
- 'External Data' drawn as a cloud icon.
- 'Application Load Balancer' represented by an ALB icon.
- An orange boundary box representing 'Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)' containing three component nodes: 'Pricing Engine', 'Pricing Workers (CPU)', and 'Pricing Workers (GPU)'.
- A purple boundary box representing 'Amazon ElastiCache for Redis' containing four internal components: 'Task Queues', 'Processing Queues', 'Pup/Sub', and 'Payload'.

2. Trace Edges:
- Yellow arrow from Users down to External Data.
- Yellow arrow from External Data up to Application Load Balancer.
- Yellow arrow from Application Load Balancer to Pricing Engine.
- Yellow arrows from Pricing Engine to Task Queues and Payload.
- Yellow arrows connecting Task Queues, Processing Queues, Pricing Workers (CPU), and Pricing Workers (GPU).
- Yellow arrows connecting Pricing Workers (CPU) and Pricing Workers (GPU) bidirectionally/multi-line with Payload.
- 'Pup/Sub' is drawn inside ElastiCache without active arrows connected to it.

graph.name: DBS Bank Quantitative Pricing Engine Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture for DBS Bank's quantitative pricing engine built on AWS ECS and ElastiCache for Redis.

nodes.name: Pricing Engine
nodes.notes: Routes task metadata and payload data

nodes.name: Task Queues
nodes.notes: Stores job IDs and pending tasks

nodes.name: Processing Queues
nodes.notes: Stores in-flight task items being processed by workers

nodes.name: Pup/Sub
nodes.notes: PubSub channel for result availability notifications

nodes.name: Payload
nodes.notes: Stores full trade and market data payloads and computation results

edges.notes: User triggers request incorporating external market data
External data routed into Application Load Balancer
ALB routes request traffic into Pricing Engine
Pricing engine places job ID into Task Queues
Pricing engine stores data payload in Redis Payload cache
CPU pricing workers monitor and pick tasks from Task Queues
Popped tasks moved into Processing Queues
CPU worker retrieves payload from Redis Payload
CPU worker saves calculation results back into Redis Payload
GPU workers monitor dedicated GPU tasks in Task Queues
GPU worker fetches payload from Redis Payload
GPU worker stores computed results back into Redis Payload
